text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a magnificent day! A dawn of 
daybreak-rose reminiscent of Genesis 
itself! The chirping of little birds 
singing praise to life!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And then, raining down from all around, 
were voices of blessing—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To think the anniversary of the day I 
descended upon this realm would turn out 
to be so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're even more hyper than usual. Even 
this morning, the second you woke up, you 
threw the curtains wide open...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I take it you've come to give me your 
congratulations? I shall gladly accept 
them, my soul brother.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, day of jubilation! Thanks be to this 
moment! For on this day the gears of my 
fate began to turn, I am able to converse 
like this with my soul sibling!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Come! Shower me with all your blessings!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know. Isn't this already cause 
enough for celebration?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... Then let me ask you one thing. Was 
that grenadine syrup in our castle's 
fridge yours? Unusual for a sweet-hater.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... I see, I see! So that is your 
way of offering blessings! Then I shall 
accept it with gratitude!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, I haven't even said anything yet.
